description: This PHP source file defines a controller class for account password recovery workflows in an OpenCart e-commerce system. It handles forgotten password requests, confirmation, reset, and password updating, including rendering views, processing form data, and managing tokens.

classes.name: Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Account\Forgotten
classes.description: Controller class for managing user account password recovery processes, including handling forgotten password requests, confirmation, token validation, and password reset.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the forgotten password page with breadcrumbs and common layout components.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Processes the password reset confirmation, validates email, generates a reset token, and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Handles resetting the password using a token, including token validation and rendering the password reset form.

methods.name: password
methods.description: Processes the submission of a new password, validates input, updates the password, and manages session tokens.
